tours.name: Restore an Archived Record
tours.description: Learn how to find an archived record with the Archived filter and bring it back, using a time off type as the example.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to find an archived record with the Archived filter and bring it back, using a time off type as the example.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: Any archived record can be restored from the list it was archived from. Time off types are used as the example here.

description_i18n.en_US: Any archived record can be restored from the list it was archived from. Time off types are used as the example here.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists used by the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists used by the Time Off app.

steps.title: Time Off Types
steps.description: Archived records are hidden from the list by default, so you will not see them yet.

description_i18n.en_US: Archived records are hidden from the list by default, so you will not see them yet.

steps.title: Search options
steps.content: Click here to open the search options.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the search options.

steps.description: The filters of the list are in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: The filters of the list are in this menu.

steps.title: Archived filter
steps.content: Click Archived to show only the archived records.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Archived to show only the archived records.

steps.description: The list now shows the records that were archived, which are normally hidden.

description_i18n.en_US: The list now shows the records that were archived, which are normally hidden.

steps.title: Find the record
steps.content: Type the name of the record and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the record and press Enter.

steps.description: Search to find the archived record you want to bring back.

description_i18n.en_US: Search to find the archived record you want to bring back.

steps.title: Select it
steps.content: Tick the box in front of the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in front of the record.

steps.description: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked.

description_i18n.en_US: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

steps.title: Unarchive
steps.description: The record is active again. It returns to the normal lists and to the choices in other forms, with all its history intact.

description_i18n.en_US: The record is active again. It returns to the normal lists and to the choices in other forms, with all its history intact.
